A huge black wolf came out of the trees and went after the mother. I was terrified for them. 😥 Just when I thought the worst would happen, a cougar appeared! She stood her ground and bravely drove the wolf away. My heart was pounding. The cougar approached the crying cub, and I just held my breath, not knowing what she would do.
